text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus achieves a splendid result at 
the Hanshin JF. However, her joy is 
short-lived...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race. Checking Ikuno Dictus's 
condition with "IRON WILL," it indicates 
an estimated fatigue level of 89%.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the Trainer and Ikuno Dictus 
immediately began their post-race 
maintenance, Mejiro McQueen came walking 
over.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After watching the race, Mejiro McQueen 
declared that she, too, would definitely 
prove the fruits of her daily dedication 
through her running one day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus registers the Triple Tiara 
races into "IRON WILL." The first goal in 
sight is the first crown, the Oka Sho.
